steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application with proof of experience and education. Pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy guides you through each step so you avoid delays or rejection.

Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to keep your competitive edge in the Baton Rouge job market.
